queries.name: GetServiceRequest
queries.output: immutable identity, official/local business IDs, revision, current accepted source projection when available, linked root RFC count, Device Reference count, warnings
rules: business-ID lookup resolves one surviving SR
historical/terminal presentation never creates another entity

queries.name: GetRfc
queries.output: immutable identity, canonical RFC No., current Customer or unresolved, derived hierarchy role, local archive state, current accepted source projection, counts/warnings
queries.rule: master/subordinate/standalone role is derived from active rfc_hierarchy_edges

queries.name: GetRfcBranch
queries.output: RfcBranchV1: root plus keyset-paginated direct subordinate rows, exact semantic CursorV1 continuation body, and complete-branch SOMA_RFC_BRANCH_FINGERPRINT_V1
queries.ordering: direct subordinate rfc_id ASC; root is fixed context and is not repeated as a paginated child row
rules: root must be parentless
page_size is 1..500 with default 100
branch_fingerprint covers the complete structural branch and is independent of page size/cursor
no arbitrary child-count cap
no recursive traversal beyond one child level
known branch Customer mismatch is invariant failure, unresolved member is explicit warning

queries.name: GetServiceRequestRfcBranches
queries.output: one bounded keyset page of logical branch-member rows grouped for presentation by governing root; each row carries direct root-link provenance, member_rfc_id and root|subordinate role
queries.ordering: root_rfc_id ASC, role_ordinal ASC where root=0 and subordinate=1, member_rfc_id ASC
rules: no subordinate direct link is synthesized
root link provenance is repeated only as bounded query projection, never copied into subordinate persistence
WFM/Task data joined through owning LLD interfaces, not copied into SR relationship rows

queries.name: GetEffectiveServiceRequestContextForRfc
queries.output: bounded keyset page of direct active SR relationships for the governing root; subordinate requests include inherited_via_root identity on each projected row
queries.rule: inherited context is query-derived and never persisted as subordinate sr_rfc_links

queries.name: ListTicketDeviceReferences
queries.output: active Device Reference identities/current operational names plus optional registration projection supplied by LLD-08
rules: registration projection is optional derived metadata
query never substitutes network_element_id for device_reference_id

queries.name: GetRfcDeviceContextForBranch
queries.output: one bounded keyset page of root/subordinate Device Reference rows carrying owning_rfc_id, role and device_reference_id so presentation can group without copying ownership
queries.rule: sets are not unioned into copied branch ownership; UI may display a derived union/grouping only with source RFC provenance

queries.name: ListWorkingNotes
queries.output: keyset page of active note identity, current body, revision, immutable created_at_utc, updated_at_utc, and creating Local User Profile identity
rules: current active note content only; audit/history surfaces provide prior edited/removed content
creator identity remains available independently of mutable display metadata
imports never participate in note mutation

queries.name: PreviewRfcHierarchyMutation
queries.output: exact current old/new structural branch fingerprints and edge/revision context, blockers/warnings, bounded LLD-05 RfcHierarchyHistoryAuthorityV1, review_required and SOMA_RFC_HIERARCHY_REVIEW_V1 fingerprint when provider READY
queries.ordering: closed validator order; bounded single mutation preview
rules: one stable read snapshot is used for all LLD-03 facts and the LLD-05 history authority
old parent/edge and base revisions are server-resolved; client role/old-parent state is never authority
INDETERMINATE provider returns no review_fingerprint and cannot authorize reparent/detach
READY LOW returns review_required=false; READY HIGH returns review_required=true
review_fingerprint binds exact old/new structural branch authority, old edge, history risk/count/provider fingerprint, blockers and warnings
the review fingerprint changes when relevant LLD-05 history changes even if the RFC hierarchy and LOW/HIGH classification do not
read-only advisory preview; command reconstructs the same authority inside its writer UnitOfWork before receipt/mutation

queries.name: PreviewSrRfcLink
queries.output: resolved governing root, current duplicate state, subordinate-origin provenance, exact current SR/RFC lifecycle evidence and revisions, terminal/historical review-required state, relationship/context impact summary
rules: a proposed new link involving terminal/historical current presentation is review-required and the review binds to the exact lifecycle evidence shown
an already-active pair remains semantic NO_CHANGE
preview cannot merge entities/devices/tasks/notes and cannot authorize stale mutation

pagination: All unbounded collections use CURSOR_V1 deterministic keyset cursors with page_size constrained by packet bounds. No product business cap such as 20 RFC children is introduced, and no query materializes an unbounded child/device/SR collection before paging.
